firmware.title: Nothing OS 4.1(FroggerPro-B4.1-260522-1414)
firmware.description:
What's New in This Update Camera Enhancements

🎥 4K 60FPS recording is now available on main and telephoto cameras, for smoother footage.
🛠️ Enhanced camera stability for smoother video zoom and time-lapse experience.

General Improvements and Bug Fixes

📱 Optimised maximum font size display to prevent text from overlapping in the UI.
⌚ Optimised the compatibility with certain wearable devices.
⚙️ Enhanced overall system stability.
🛡️ Updated to May 2026 security patch.

Notes:
Your device may use more power and feel warmer during installation. Performance will return to normal after the update is complete.

firmware.title: Nothing OS 4.1(FroggerPro-B4.1-260723-1820)
firmware.description:
What's New in This Update Essential Voice Enhancements

🔡 You can now customise whether a long-press or a double-click of the Essential Key triggers translation or transcription while typing. Set it up in Settings > Intelligence toolkit > Essential Voice > Customise Essential Key.
⌨️ Quick switch between translation and transcription is now available by long-pressing the icon on the keyboard.

Camera Enhancements

📹 Lock Lens keeps your video framing steady by preventing automatic lens switching during recording. Enable in Camera settings > Lock Lens.
📷 Optimised camera memory usage for a smoother shooting experience.

General Improvements and Bug Fixes

🎚️ Refined the volume slider to allow seamless and more precise adjustment when dragging.
🔐 Added a security reminder for the face unlock method.
⚙️ Enhanced overall system stability.
🛡️ Updated to July 2026 security patch.

Notes:
Your device may use more power and feel warmer during installation. Performance will return to normal after the update is complete.
